protocol.training: unweighted normalized residual MSE; identical architecture, optimizer, initialization seeds and epoch budget
protocol.validation: new shared episodes; select rule once, ridge penalty and NN epoch/initialization separately at each size
protocol.large_change: threshold from original smallest training set, frozen for all sizes within each split
protocol.point_estimate_gate: largest NN improves large-change MAE over smallest NN; ordinary/overall degrade <=2% by default
limits: More episodes also permit more optimizer updates per epoch; this is not a fixed-compute study.
One nested training sequence per policy split; no claim that data alone limit accuracy.
All sizes use the same fresh test episodes; none are selected using test error.
Paired bootstrap resamples episodes; subgroup comparisons are exploratory and unadjusted.
Standard GridWorld, on-policy, complete horizons only; no action intervention.
